name: Pakistani taxes on construction (federal GST, provincial services tax, income tax withheld)
name_ur: تعمیرات پر پاکستانی ٹیکس (وفاقی جی ایس ٹی، صوبائی سروسز ٹیکس، کٹوتی شدہ انکم ٹیکس)
standard: Sales Tax Act, 1990; provincial sales tax on services laws; Income Tax Ordinance, 2001, section 153
review_status: unconfirmed. Pending review by a Pakistani tax adviser. Rates marked provisional come from secondary sources and are not enforced.
scope_note: Goods are taxed by the federation and services by the province, so a construction bill has no single national rate. The sales tax is a line of its own; the person confirming the bill picks the rate for the province and the payer.
description: Federal sales tax on goods is 18 percent. Construction services are taxed by the province where they are rendered. Income tax is withheld from a payment under a works contract at 7.5 percent (company on the Active Taxpayer List), 15 percent (company off the list), 8 percent (other payee on the list) or 16 percent (other payee off the list), under section 153(1)(c) of the Income Tax Ordinance.
